title: Print Heading Chip Border Fix
description: Fix colored chapter/section/subsection heading chips to render like paragraphs (canvas fill with visible accent borders) instead of solid colored fill with no visible border.
summary:
Fixed chapter/section/subsection heading chips rendering as solid accent-filled blocks without visible borders.

Root cause: `\semio@heading@chip` delegated to `\semio@window@cap`, which used `\colorbox` with tier accent fill and matching stroke color (invisible borders).

Fix in print/tex/semio-window.sty:
- `\semio@heading@chip` now uses the same bordered canvas cap primitive as paragraphs (`\semio@paragraph@cap@muted@vbox` + gray hairline strokes) with emphasized foreground text.
- `\semio@heading@pair` gap cutout uses `semio-chrome-border-normal` like muted pairs.
- `\semio@heading@installall` registers `\chapter` and `\part` when available.

Verified by rebuilding report and forschungsbericht PDFs and rasterizing body pages.
